Prevention: Rotate with legumes; e.g. groundnut, beans, soybeans and root and tubers such as pototes where possible.
Apply fertilizer (FYM) at the rate of 10 t/ha one week before planting.
Napier grass on the border (outside the field) as trap crop
Uproot volunteer plants in maize crop
For fields with stalk borer infestation, remove stalks that remain after harvest by uprooting and use them in making compost.
Monitoring: Check into stalks (at 30 cm height & at flowering stage)
Check if there are holes, dead heart, tunnelling in the stem
For older plants, check in cobs (caterpillars bore into the cobs)
Threshold: take action when 10% of plants are infested
Direct Control: L of water per 20 plants) at 8-10 days interval
Uproot infested plants and use them to make composts
Restrictions: When using a pesticide, always wear protective clothing and follow the instructions on the product label, such as dosage
Highly toxic to bees and aquatic animals.
Do not spray any plant in flower stage, around bee hives and water sources.
Do not apply if rainfall is expected within 6 hours.
